jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Environmental Genomics and Pollinator Ecology
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Ecoscience programme. The position is available from 01 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
PhD Position in Environmental Genomics and Pollinator Ecology

Research area and project description
Pollinating insects are declining globally due to habitat loss, climate change, pesticides and emerging diseases. While conservation efforts typically focus on terrestrial habitats and floral resources, the role of freshwater ecosystems in supporting pollinator populations remains poorly understood.
Recent evidence suggests that ponds, streams and wetlands can act as important biodiversity hotspots for insect pollinators, providing hydration, microclimatic refugia, microbial resources and potentially novel nutritional supplements. However, the mechanisms linking freshwater habitats and pollinator health remain largely unexplored.

This PhD project will investigate how freshwater ecosystems influence pollinator diversity, diet, microbiomes and health. The work will combine field ecology, environmental DNA (eDNA), DNA metabarcoding, high-throughput sequencing, bioinformatics and AI-assisted monitoring technologies to uncover how aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems interact to support biodiversity.

The candidate will become part of a growing and highly interdisciplinary team working at the interface of molecular ecology, pollinator ecology and freshwater science.

Research activities:
The PhD candidate will primarily contribute to:
 
• Large-scale field surveys in Danish gardens, parks and freshwater habitats.
• Environmental DNA sampling from freshwater habitats and flowers.
• DNA metabarcoding of pollinator, plant and aquatic communities.
• Analysis of pollinator foraging networks.
• Experimental studies examining insect visitation to freshwater resources.
• Development and application of AI-assisted image-based insect monitoring approaches.
• Bioinformatic analysis of sequencing data.
• Publication of research findings in international peer-reviewed journals.
The project includes opportunities for international collaboration, and a research stay with project partners at the National Botanic Garden of Wales (UK).
Project description. For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please simply copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants to the PhD position should have a master’s degree in ecology, biology, environmental science, bioinformatics, genomics, conservation biology or a related discipline.
 
• Demonstrated interest in biodiversity, pollinator ecology, freshwater ecology, or molecular ecology.
• Experience with molecular methods such as DNA extraction, PCR, metabarcoding or sequencing.
• Experience with bioinformatics, R programming, or ecological statistics.
• Interest in both field research and laboratory-based research.
• Effective communication skills in English.No candidate is expected to meet all criteria. We encourage applications from individuals with complementary skills and a strong interest in developing expertise across ecology, environmental genomics, and biodiversity monitoring.

Place of employment and place of work:
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Aarhus University, Frederiksborgvej 399, DK-4000 Roskilde, Denmark.

Contacts:
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Georgina Brennan, g.brennan@ecos.au.dk (supervisor and primary contact for project-related enquiries)
• Nikolai Friberg, niko@ecos.au.dk (supervisor)
For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk
How to apply:
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 30 October 2026 at 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 February 2027.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which everyone has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants. All interested candidates are encouraged to apply, regardless of their personal background. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with applicable collective agreement.

jobs.occupation: PhD in gas photonics - DTU Electro
jobs.description:
We are seeking a skilled and highly motivated PhD candidate for a 3 year position, in the fields of gas-filled hollow-core fiber lasers, ultrafast lasers, and nonlinear optics.

In this role, you will conduct cutting-edge research in ultrafast nonlinear optics using gas-filled hollow-core fiber platforms. You will develop advanced high-power near-infrared ultrafast laser sources and gas-filled fiber systems for fundamental studies and emerging photonic applications. The research will primarily be carried out in the GasLab at DTU Electro, which provides state-of-the-art infrastructure for exploratory gas-laser experiments and a collaborative environment for training and mentoring project personnel.

Our expectations of you
We expect the successful candidate to have:

• A MSc degree in optics/photonics, optical engineering.
• Interest and background with exploring unknown physics in the field of nonlinear photonics and ultrafast lasers. 
• Experimental experience with developing fiber lasers, with preference on gas-filled hollow-core fiber lasers.
• The ability to work independently, and contribute creatively to research projects, and the ability to maintain an organized and safe work environment.
• The candidate should be fluent in English, both written and spoken.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility. 

Salary and terms of employment
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. The allowance will be agreed upon with the relevant union. The period of employment is 3 years.

The position is a full-time position. The starting date will be January 01, 2027 or according to mutual agreement

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Dr. Yazhou Wang (yazwang@dtu.dk) and Assoc. Prof. Christos Markos (chmar@dtu.dk). 

You can read more about DTU Electro at https://electro.dtu.dk. 

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 31 October 2026 (23:59 Danish time). 

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• List of publications 
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Electro 
DTU Electro employs more than 300 skilled researchers with competencies in electrical and photonics engineering. As a department we strive towards creating sustainable energy and a greener internet, as well as strengthening cyber security and health technology. Working with the industry and public organizations is one of our top priorities to find and implement new solutions to our society. We aim to offer education, research, and innovation of the highest standard, and our focus on application-oriented research enables us to work across many engineering disciplines and research areas, such as IT and the medical and health sciences. We have a close collaboration with researchers from all over the world, just as we collaborate with industry and public authorities about the dissemination of solutions based on electrical and photonics engineering as their key enabling technologies.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Data Science
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an internship that combines personal development and the opportunity to support the green transition through data-based insights? Are you passionate about working hands-on with data? Are you eager to turn your theoretical knowledge into practical and customer-centred solutions?

Here is what the job entails

In the role as our Intern in Data Science, you will participate in various projects while working hands-on with data from our meters and related software, systems, and services. Through data analysis, you will help generate insights that support utilities and contribute to the green transition.

More specifically, you will be:

• Working with geographical, topological, voltage, and energy consumption time series data from distributed electricity meters

• Applying physical modelling, data analysis, and potentially machine learning-based methods to real customer data and business cases

• Exploring how meter data can be used to improve understanding of the opportunities, limitations and challenges of the electricity grid

• Driving your own defined project with continuous sparring and feedback from colleagues

As our intern, you will be enrolled in various projects where your ideas and inputs create real value for customers. Throughout your internship, you will experience development opportunities through regular interaction with skilled colleagues, feedback from stakeholders, and the opportunity to connect theoretical knowledge with practical business and customer challenges.

Meet your future team

With a direct reference to Director, Product Portfolio Management, you will join a dedicated team, currently consisting of 9 dedicated colleagues. Together, we are driven by our mission to help utilities handle increased electrification and the transition to a greener future through smart metering, grid insights, data analysis, and customer-centred solutions. With our diverse backgrounds, we combine deep technical expertise, practical customer understanding, while sharing a strong ambition to show how models and data can create real value. In the team, you will experience a collaborative and curious atmosphere, with room for both predefined projects and your own ideas.

Did you know? We use meter data to solve problems that most people do not even realize exist.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated and curious Intern, who is ready to turn theoretical insights into practical solutions involving electricity grids, energy transport, and meter data. You are comfortable sharing your ideas and perspectives, challenging existing ways of working, and collaborating with colleagues across the organisation.

In order to succeed we imagine that you:

• Are studying a degree in physics, engineering, data science, or a related analytical field

• Possess strong theoretical knowledge and an ability to work independently

• Have interest in data analysis, physical modelling, and potentially machine learning-based approaches

• Can apply your analytical mindset to identify new innovative ways of working

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door. It is a requirement that you can work onsite during the semester.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Director, Product Management - Electricity, Thomas Dezhkam Kristensen, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Material Chemistry at the Mads Clausen Institute – Sønderborg
jobs.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic new colleague as a PhD student in the field of Materials Chemistry with a strong background, particularly in Solid State Chemistry and Crystal Structure Analysis, and interest in industrial applications and cooperation to join the Mads Clausen Institute (MCI) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in Sønderborg, Denmark. The position is for three years with a preferred starting date of March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible. 

MCI is a part of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and covers research and education, including applications of engineering sciences. Our working language is English, reflecting the fact that far more than half of our students and staff are international. We are located at SDU’s beautiful campus in Sønderborg, in the inspiring building of Alsion, which is a centre for science, culture, and learning in the heart of Sønderborg and perched on the strait of water separating the island of Als from the mainland. The university has very close relations with industries in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany.

The successful candidate is expected to carry out research mainly within a project funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. The research work involves the synthesis and characterization of novel compounds based on mixed-anion compounds (e.g., transition metal (oxy)nitrides) and the evaluation of their performance in solar water splitting. Also, the successful candidate is expected to be actively involved in the supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students affiliated with SDU NanoSYD, preparing project reports, presentations, and publications, as well as writing grants for supporting research at SDU NanoSYD. 

 

Job Description and Responsibilities:

• 
Implementation of research tasks related to the project

• 
Collaborative and independent research planning, materials synthesis and characterization, crystal structure analysis, and performance evaluation of materials in solar water splitting

• 
Independent characterization, data analysis, and interpretation of research results

• 
Scientific communication and presentation of research results at group seminars, scientific conferences, project meetings, etc.

• 
Writing and publishing of project results in international high-impact scientific journals

Additional Responsibilities may be requested in:

• 
Supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students who perform research work on similar research topics 

• 
Assistance in teaching activities 

• 
Assistance in the preparation of grant proposals for external funding

• 
Assistance in laboratory organization and management 

 

Qualifications (as required):

• 
MSc degree in Materials Science, Materials Chemistry, Solid State Chemistry, Solid State Physics, or related fields 

• 
Proven hands-on experience and knowledge of various synthesis methods in solid-state chemistry, preferably the methods used for the synthesis of mixed-anion compounds

• 
Technical skills in materials characterization techniques (e.g., XRD, XPS, SEM, etc.)       

• 
Technical skills in crystal structure analysis 

• 
Fluency in English (both spoken and written)

• 
Ability to work both in teams and independently 

• 
Strong communication and social skills 

• 
Willingness to collaborate with other scientists and industry 

Qualifications (as assets):

• 
Research experience in X-ray, synchrotron, and neutron radiation facilities

• 
Research experience in solid state chemistry and crystal structure analysis 

• 
A track record of experience in writing scientific publications

• 
Technical skills in scientific illustration and animation to deliver visual knowledge of the project 

• 
Proven record in participating in national and international research projects and programs

• 
Strong interest in a long-term commitment to a growing research group

 

Contact information

Further information is available from Prof. Mirabbos Hojamberdiev (mirabbos@mci.sdu.dk; Tel: +45 6550 7483 or the Head of the Institute, Prof. Dr. Horst-Günter Rubahn (rubahn@mci.sdu.dk). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying, candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
One-page motivation letter that describes the applicant’s educational background and previous research experience most relevant to the offered position and the reason for applying to the PhD program.  

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
Research statement on developing novel mixed anion compounds, particularly metal (oxy)nitrides, for solar water splitting may also be included.

• 
References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Hardware Engineer: Lead the integration of the hardware that powers ambitious satellite missions
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Hardware Engineer to drive the integration, technical ownership, and continuous improvement of the hardware platforms that enable GomSpace's satellite missions.

You will join our Satellite Systems Business Unit in Aalborg and play a central role in supporting satellite missions from proposal and electrical design through assembly, integration, testing, and delivery to customers worldwide. You will work closely with hardware designers, systems engineers, AIV engineers, manufacturing teams, and project managers while helping shape the future development of our hardware engineering capabilities.

Your Role

As experienced Hardware Engineer, you will act as the technical lead for the integration of electrical hardware and GomSpace products into satellite platforms.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Own the technical integration of GomSpace products into nanosatellite and microsatellite missions.

• Serve as a product expert for GomSpace hardware platforms, interfaces, functionality, configuration, and performance.

• Drive technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis during development, integration, testing, and customer projects.

• Lead the integration and verification of new GomSpace products and third-party hardware within satellite platforms.

• Define electrical interface solutions, schematic-level designs, harness concepts, and supporting hardware required for mission integration.

• Coordinate prototyping, validation, documentation, and manufacturing introduction activities for new hardware solutions.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers.

• Support technical decision-making and trade-off analyses across customer programmes and internal developments.

• Contribute to process improvements, engineering standards, and product maturity initiatives across the organisation.

• Support proposal activities and customer discussions by providing credible technical solutions, effort estimates, and engineering input.

• Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively in English, including technical reports, specifications, procedures, and interactions with international stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

In the initial phase, success means:

• Becoming a recognised technical expert on GomSpace's hardware portfolio.

• Successfully leading hardware integration activities on active customer missions.

• Resolving complex technical issues through systematic troubleshooting and engineering analysis.

• Building strong working relationships with Satellite Systems HW Team, Products HW Team, AIV, Manufacturing, and Systems Engineering.

• Supporting the growth and development of less experienced engineers.

Over time, you will be recognised as a trusted technical authority for hardware integration and product implementation, driving engineering excellence and helping scale GomSpace's hardware capabilities as our missions and teams continue to grow.

What You Bring

You are an experienced hardware engineer who enjoys solving technically demanding challenges and transforming complex products into reliable space systems.

You likely bring:

• An MSc or BSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in hardware design, hardware integration, electronics development, verification, or systems integration.

• Strong knowledge of digital electronics, embedded hardware, and microcontroller-based systems.

• Experience with hardware communication interfaces and buses, including RS485/-422, CAN, SPI, I²C, USB, Ethernet, Spacewire, or similar.

• Experience in schematic capture and hardware development using tools such as Altium Designer or equivalent.

• Understanding of PCB design principles, EMC-, grounding- and shielding considerations, manufacturing processes, and product industrialisation.

• Experience with electrical integration, harness design, laboratory testing, and troubleshooting.

• Practical understanding of power systems, communication systems, and embedded electronics.

• Experience working with multidisciplinary engineering teams and complex technical projects.

• Knowledge of space systems and ECSS standards would be a strong advantage.

• Experience leading technical activities, mentoring engineers, or coordinating engineering teams would be considered a significant benefit.

Who You Are

You are pragmatic, technically curious, and motivated by solving challenging engineering problems.

You are known for:

• Technical leadership – providing direction and guidance without necessarily having formal authority.

• Systems thinking – understanding how individual hardware components contribute to mission success.

• Problem solving – methodically analysing issues and driving them to resolution.

• Collaboration – building strong relationships across engineering disciplines.

• Ownership – taking responsibility for delivering results.

• Mentorship – helping colleagues develop and grow.

• Customer focus – understanding that engineering excellence is measured by mission success.

• True leadership – setting standards, building trust, and enabling others to perform at their best.

Why Join Us

You will play a key role in delivering some of Europe's most ambitious nanosatellite and microsatellite missions, working at the intersection of product development, systems engineering, and customer delivery.

This position offers the opportunity to influence technical decisions across multiple programmes, shape future hardware capabilities, and grow into broader technical or people leadership responsibilities as both the team and business continue to expand.

Join our mission

We encourage you to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact:

Kelly Antonini

Systems Engineering and Hardware Manager

klan@gomspace.com

Workplace: Langagervej 6, 9220 Aalborg East, Denmark. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorized third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

We kindly draw your attention to the fact that we do not receive applications and resumes via e-mail or by personal appearance. This is to protect and show consideration for your personal information. Apply for the job by following the link below.

About GomSpace

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturised radio technology. At the core of our mission are our values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. jobs.occupation: Experienced Systems Engineer – Architecting Nanosatellite & Microsatellite Systems (DK/LU)
jobs.description:
Do you want to own the technical integrity of a mission from "blank sheet" to flight-ready hardware?

GomSpace is seeking a Lead Systems Engineer to drive our next generation of Nanosatellite and Microsatellite missions. We are looking for a technical visionary who thrives on solving complex system trade-offs for both bespoke single-satellite missions and scaling constellation architectures. In this role, you will navigate the newest market developments, helping our customers transition from initial technology demonstrators to operational fleets.

Since 2007, GomSpace has developed and delivered satellites to customers across more than 60 countries worldwide through technological innovation and the efforts of our highly skilled team.

You will have the chance to be part of an international and dedicated team committed to providing exceptional and innovative small-satellite solutions to customers in the global market. Your objectives will be aligned with your personal development goals, and you will be given the autonomy to lead others towards the same direction.

About the Job

As a Lead Systems Engineer in the Satellite Systems Business Unit, you are the technical heart of the mission. You aren’t just managing requirements; you are architecting the system and ensuring its physical realization. You will bridge the gap between customer vision and engineering execution, guiding teams through the full development lifecycle. You will have the autonomy to make high-impact technical decisions across a diverse portfolio, ensuring exceptional performance for single spacecraft and emerging constellation projects.

Responsibilities include:

• Defining and Architecting end-to-end missions, scaling designs from high-performance single satellites to repeatable constellation architectures.

• Driving the full development lifecycle, from proposal response and mission analysis to design, assembly, integration, and testing (AIT).

• Serving as the Technical Authority in front of the customer, translating complex needs into robust system specifications and verifiable requirements.

• Process Excellence: Designing and implementing value-added engineering processes that maintain high quality without sacrificing the speed required in an agile "New Space" environment.

• Leading and Mentoring project systems teams to solve the industry’s toughest challenges in power, thermal, and high-precision pointing.

• Managing complex interfaces and risk profiles, ensuring seamless integration between payload, bus, and launch providers.

Your profile

You are a driven and dedicated professional with a strong focus on delivering high-quality, advanced solutions. You thrive in collaborative and agile environments.

• Proven Experience: Significant years in a Lead or Senior Systems role within the space industry. Experience taking a satellite through the full "design-to-test" lifecycle is essential.

• Process Champion: You have a deep understanding of where to focus effort in the engineering process. You are skilled at implementing streamlined workflows that add genuine value and encourage team adoption in fast-paced environments.

• The "System" Thinker: You understand how a single component change can affect mission-level link budgets, thermal margins, or mass properties.

• Cross-Disciplinary Communicator: Comfortable discussing software configurations with developers, high-speed data links with RF engineers, structural margins with mechanical leads, etc.—everything that goes into a satellite solution.

• Leadership through Action: You foster a culture of helpfulness and open communication, leading by example in both technical depth and professional integrity.

This position is based in Denmark (Aalborg) or Luxembourg (Esch-sur-Alzette). The expected travel activity is 15 -40 days per year, and we are highly receptive to international applicants.

Qualifications:

• MSc-level (or higher) engineering education in aerospace, systems, software, electrical engineering, or related fields.

• Mastery of ECSS/NASA standards, with the ability to tailor these processes to be effective and agile.

• Expertise in systems engineering principles, including requirements management, architecture, and system-level verification and testing.

• Proficiency in mission analysis tools (e.g., STK, GMAT) for coverage, revisit, and orbital analysis.

• Demonstrated ability to design and drive engineering processes that improve team efficiency and product reliability.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks in space missions or projects.

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

Why choose GomSpace?

• Growth: Providing leadership within a leading space-industry company where innovation and advanced technologies are used to make a positive societal impact.

• Impact: Working alongside passionate, skilled, and international colleagues, driven by curiosity about “New Space” opportunities.

• Culture: Operating in a dynamic and cooperative culture with transparent communication and multidisciplinary teams.

• Network: Learning and growing through the company’s global network of locations and partnerships.

• International: Being part of project work based on international standards and team-oriented approaches.

JOIN OUR MISSION

Please send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position do not hesitate to contact: Evan Helmeid, Systems Engineering, evhe@gomspace.com

Workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6, Aalborg, Denmark, or 1 Boulevard du Jazz, Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

jobs.occupation: Accounting & Reporting Advisory – Assistant Manager to Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 3,000 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology and Transformations.

Join our growth journey with our Accounting & Reporting Advisory team (ARA)

You will become a part of our Accounting & Reporting Advisory team (ARA), an ambitious group dedicated to creating value by advising on complex accounting and external reporting needs. This includes conversion to IFRS, preparation of IFRS financial statements in connection with conversions or improvements, technical accounting analyses and issues, solving general accounting problems, improvement of financial reporting processes and control environments, and various M&A accounting services.

The Accounting & Reporting Advisory team is a component of our Assurance Offerings department that specializes in advising CFO’s and finance functions on, amongst others, projects within accounting, ESG reporting & assurance, optimisation of financial processes, digital solutions as well as complex IFRS analysis and implementation projects.

In Assurance Offerings, we foster a culture that accommodates everyone, irrespective of their life situation. We place great importance on well-being and development, striving to create an environment where each talent can leverage their strengths and competencies.

Job Description

As part of our team, you will lead and participate in client projects using your specialised accounting knowledge and the Deloitte Toolkit. We are looking for candidates on a manager level who are capable of leading projects with up to five team members, being responsible for scoping projects in cooperation with clients and project partners, as well as supporting and advising clients’ corporate accounting and reporting teams.

We work with assistance and advice within:

• General assistance regarding IFRS (ad hoc questions or short/long-term temporary tasks)

• Supporting clients in optimizing their financial reporting processes, ensuring timely, efficient and quality external reporting

• Assisting clients with consolidations and system implementation, improving their close processes and financial data flows from source to report

• Practical assistance/advice on finance, accounting and reporting

• Conversions to IFRS

• Supporting the clients specialised finance function with analysing and documenting the accounting treatment of proposed or actual transactions

• Assistance with the due diligence process in connection with business transactions (e.g., selected accounting areas, preparation of memos, preparation of due diligence material)

• Accounting assistance after company acquisition to support subsequent integration

• Treasury accounting including design and implementation of hedge accounting and processes and controls supporting clients running an effective hedge accounting setup

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Qualifications

You see challenges as an exciting opportunity to bring your talent into play and are prepared to learn and solve often complex tasks from scratch.

• You have experience in the field. You have minimum 5 years of experience from a similar job within finance or accounting, e.g., auditor, finance manager, accounting manager, or consultant in a related area.

• You are a positive and independent team player. You take ownership of tasks and do not shy away from new challenges. You value and embrace diverse perspectives and collaborate to create security and trust among your colleagues and clients.

• You have a relevant master's degree in finance, accounting, or auditing.

• Fluent in English – Fluent in Danish is an advantage.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click "I am interested" above if you are ready to be part of our team.

Send your application, CV, and a transcript of your latest education along with other relevant documents. We process applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we recommend that you send your application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Amalie Andersen, Senior Manager, at +45 28 92 66 04.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team's success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position, regardless of age, gender (gender identity or expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

jobs.occupation: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Spirii is looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer.

If you are passionate about cloud software development, team collaboration, and creating outstanding backend code, join Spirii's fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. Our Digital Development department is proud to drive a listen, learn, and lead culture that allows us to constantly improve our ways of working, including how we adopt AI to raise the quality and speed of our engineering.

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer in our Payments team, you will help enhance the backbone of the Spirii platform that turns charging data into accurate invoices, credit memos, and payouts. It's a domain where correctness and financial data integrity are non-negotiable. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with CPH and near-shore colleagues, as well as Finance and partner teams.

What You Will Do

Together with your team, you will be responsible for:

• 
Designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure backend services and cloud-native queue-based pipelines (Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript) that power data ingestion, processing, and invoice generation at high throughput.

• 
Ensuring data quality through correct aggregation and safe handling of late or updated records.

• 
Building and maintaining integrations with internal services and our ERP system.

• 
Significantly contributing to architectural decisions and solution design for cloud-native, distributed, event-driven systems on AWS.

• 
Driving automated testing and observability to protect billing correctness and catch data discrepancies early.

• 
Mentoring other engineers and raising the technical bar of the team through code review, pairing, and constructive feedback.

• 
Operating independently on ambiguous, cross-team problems with minimal oversight.

• 
Using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to accelerate development and automate repetitive tasks while helping the team adopt AI safely in a financially sensitive codebase.

Who You Are

• 
Like to explore innovative technologies, including AI tools and agentic workflows, and continuously expand your skills.

• 
Ambitious and execution-focused, with strong ability to balance functional and non-functional requirements when designing solutions.

• 
A proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership of complex backend systems and actively maintaining operational awareness.

• 
Skilled at breaking down complex, ambiguous initiatives into vertical slices that deliver value incrementally; you default to shipping in small, regular batches rather than big-bang releases.

• 
Comfortable working in Agile, cross-functional teams (backend, frontend, Finance, partners), and an active participant in creating an open, collaborative environment.

• 
Excellent English communication skills and the ability to interact with all levels of the organization, internally and externally with partners/customers.

Qualifications

• 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 
7+ years of professional software development experience.

• 
Extensive hands-on experience designing and scaling production backend systems, including having designed event-driven, queue/job-based architectures.

• 
Strong experience building TypeScript or JavaScript (Node.js, NestJS) microservices on cloud platforms such as AWS.

• 
Experience leading design discussions, mentoring engineers, or acting as a technical point of contact for a team or domain.

• 
Hands-on experience with test-driven development, test automation, integration and load testing.

• 
Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with the discipline needed for financially accurate, auditable data.

• 
Experience integrating external and internal IT systems, and solid API design.

• 
Experience with developing secure software is a plus.

• 
Knowledge of Redis and NoSQL databases is an advantage.

• 
Experience working with or integrating ERP systems (e.g. Microsoft Business Central) is an advantage.

• 
Experience with billing, payments, invoicing, or other financial/transactional systems is a strong plus.

• 
Hands-on experience using AI assistants and/or agentic workflows to improve engineering productivity is a plus.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• 
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer, React
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building software and high-performance web applications? Can you develop within a complex system? And are you experienced with React? If so, then you might be our next Senior Software Engineer at JYSK, where you'll take technical ownership and create intuitive and outstanding solutions for our store employees to help them even more with their everyday tasks.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will be working in a cross functional agile scrum team that consist of frontend and backend engineers, testers, UX specialists, a Product Owner, and an IT Delivery Lead. A highly skilled team that values open discussions, learning from each other, and solving complex challenges as a unit that plan and build features by following best practices.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• a great opportunity to develop and grow professionally and personally

• a relaxed and open-minded work environment

• plenty of opportunities to influence the technical solution

• several social activities during the year, including Friday bar, DHL run, summer and winter party etc.

• a well-functioning work-from-home policy

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Develop and maintain JYSK’s store web applications with a focus on performance and scalability.

• Work closely with team members and stakeholders to build seamless user experiences.

• Take ownership of existing applications and drive continuous improvements.

• Stay updated on latest technologies and propose new ideas for our platforms.

• Mentor and collaborate with teammates to share knowledge and grow together.

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

• At least 5 years of professional work experience with React, TypeScript and Next.js or Tanstack.

• Experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.

• Great communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams.

• Experience with scalable web applications and performance optimization.

• Can break down and priorities large and complex features into smaller tasks.

• A proactive approach to improving solutions and challenging the status quo.

• Is eager to stay up to date with latest technologies and motivated to continuously learn new things.

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

jobs.description:

You can expect a broad variety of tasks, including preparing and coordinating events (communication, analysis, practical setup for online and in-person events, and ad-hoc execution), mapping relevant stakeholders, and helping with investment activities (hosting investor events, pitch events etc.). You will also assist with strategic initiatives and delegations to/from Denmark, such as working with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, embassies, hospitals, insurance companies, municipalities and investors.

The successful candidate is expected to work with the following:

Responsibilities:

• 
Support the planning, communication and execution of our various events, including in-person and online breakout rooms.

• 
Assist in mapping and scouting relevant stakeholders and organisations for strategic partnerships in international markets, including healthcare providers, regulatory bodies, investors and industry associations.

• 
Help us manage our communications workflow.

• 
Maintain the member catalogue and keep member information up to date, with specific portfolio segments per stakeholder.

• 
Help plan our yearly activities and ensure member engagement.

• 
Help set up and prepare investor events.

Ideally, you are probably between your 4th semester of your bachelor’s or master’s programme, with 1-2 years remaining until graduation.

Structured and meticulous.

Strong analytical and research skills, with a keen interest in health market trends, market access, and investments.

Excellent communication and presentation skills in English. Additional languages are considered a plus, yet we work in English.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Strong stakeholder management skills.

A plus:

Familiarity with the health tech industry.

• 
Familiarity with CRM.

Flair for design.

What you'll gain:

• 
Exposure to the vibrant digital health ecosystem in Copenhagen.

• 
Networking opportunities with industry experts, startups, and investors.

• 
Hands-on experience in business development work.

Flexible work hours to accommodate academic commitments.

The practical bits:

15–20 hours a week, with flexibility during exams

Start as soon as possible, for a minimum of one year

Based in Copenhagen, with flexibility to work remotely when needed

A fun, informal work environment with perks like healthy lunches, team days, free coffee, and more
